review.assessment: The diff modifies `shiprate/weights.py` to implement a ceiling function for billable weight calculation instead of rounding to the nearest step, aligning customer quotes with carrier billing logic (rounding up). This resolves the financial discrepancy observed in parcel p-1 where it was quoted at 2.0 kg but billed at 2.5 kg, ensuring quotes are never lower than actual charges. The change satisfies all constraints and passes acceptance tests without regressions.
